device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: masks secrets and personal data in the text lines it is handed, so that no token, key or address in a log line can reach a scenario's result. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state. Its patterns are regular expressions; it is a safety net applied to everything a scenario returns, not a guarantee.

actionList.name: redact
actionList.description: Masks the lines you supply and returns them in the same order, with every match replaced whole by a tag: authorization header credentials, Bearer, Basic and token (<token>), GitHub tokens (<githubToken>), AWS access key ids and secret access keys (<awsKey>), private key blocks, PGP's included (<privateKey>, one line for the whole block, so the line count can change), JWTs (<jwt>), credentials in a URL (://<basicAuth>@), e-mail addresses (<email>), IPv4 addresses (<ipv4>), card-like digit runs (<card>) and phone numbers (<phone>). Also returns how many matches of each type were replaced. A count of zero is not evidence that the text holds no secret or personal data: the patterns catch the shapes listed, nothing else.
